keyframe_review.note: New keyframe for 1814, which Cliopatria lacks (its row starts in 1815): 'In 1814, an imperial decree reestablished the independence and economy of Andorra', ending the annexation to the French department of Segre. Same footprint as the 1815 shape.

380 km2 for 1815-1937 against the infobox 468 km2 (ratio 0.81, within a factor of two; the shape is one or two grid cells for a 468 km2 state). The History page: 'Andorra's borders have remained unchanged since 1278', so the footprint holds for the whole life.

404 km2 for one year, 6 percent above 1815-1937 with an identical bounding box: a raster artefact, since no event in 1938 changes the border ('Andorra's borders have remained unchanged since 1278'). The French detachment garrisoned 1936-1940 'to prevent encroachment' did not alter the border.

380 km2 for 1939-2023, the same as before 1938. The 2001 France-Andorra treaty 'rectified and amended the border slightly' and swapped two plots of about 15,925 m2 each near the Envalira tunnel; at 0.03 km2 it is invisible in the grid. 'Most of the Franco-Andorran border is determined by custom'.
380 km2 for 2024, unchanged. Infobox area 468 km2 (ratio 0.81). The Spanish frontier (64 km) and the French frontier (57 km) are given in the border pages; neither page dates a demarcation.

ledger.note: 1814: the French emperor restores Andorra's independence. 'In 1814, an imperial decree reestablished the independence and economy of Andorra', after the annexation of 1812-1813 to the department of Segre (Andorra page); the same state as the co-principality of 1278, now two co-princes: the French head of state and the Bishop of Urgell.

wars.outcome: Andorra was annexed to the French department of Segre in 1812-1813 and its independence was restored by the imperial decree of 1814.
wars.note: The page gives '1812-1813' for the annexation and 1814 for the decree, not a month.

wars.name: Spanish Civil War (French garrison in Andorra)
wars.outcome: Andorra stayed outside the war; 'From 1936 to 1940, a French detachment was garrisoned in Andorra to prevent encroachment'. No border changed.
wars.note: The page also records the 1933 French occupation after social unrest before elections (the Andorra page adds that the Joves Andorrans seized parliament on 5 April 1933). Neither page dates its end. Boris Skossyreff proclaimed himself Boris I on 6-8 July 1934 and was arrested on 20 July (Skossyreff page).

certainty.note: 'Most of the Franco-Andorran border is determined by custom' (Andorra-France border page) and the Spanish border page gives no treaty; Andorra's border is described as unchanged since 1278. The 2001 treaty fixed two swapped plots near the Envalira tunnel.

ONE STATE WITH co-principality-of-andorra. Cliopatria's 'Principality of Andorra' row (1815-2024) and the 'County of Urgell' shapes 1279-1808 (reviewed in co-principality-of-andorra by eu-12-b) are one state, Andorra (Wikidata Q228), broken by the annexation of 1812-1813. This dossier starts in 1814 on the page's date ('an imperial decree reestablished the independence'); Cliopatria's row starts in 1815. A merge into one dossier (cliopatria_names both Names) would be cleaner; the orchestrator decides.
NOT DRAWN. The French occupation of 1933 and the French garrison of 1936-1940: France's head of state is a co-prince, no page dates the end of the 1933 episode, and the garrison was to 'prevent encroachment', so no occupation_start/occupation_end pair is written. The 2001 plot swap with France (15,925 m2 each) is below the grid. The Spanish Civil War period gives no border change.
The ledger has one event (found 1814) because the pages record no other change to the footprint; this is a finding, not a gap. No ruler list (two co-princes; no page lists them).
